title: Increase announcement card
description: A framed band holding one dark navy news card with 8px corners and a long soft shadow: a white title, two lines of grey text and a mint link with an arrow at the bottom, and a photo filling the card's right side from tablet up. The whole card is the link; hovering underlines it and nudges the arrow.
notes: the card forces dark tokens with the dark class, on light or dark themes
media: a photo, cropped like cover; empty it is a muted placeholder panel (hidden on phones, as in the original)
